author: FlameKilla
body: Hello I have recently received a permanent ban by Cammy_G. I was lagging in that server as I live in Aus and many weird things had happened whilst I was playing with friends. I even died to quite bad lag as I was 2 blocks behind a wall and I was killed by a bow and arrow. No mods had gave me a warning that I was doing anything wrong. I think that they may have banned the wrong person as I was not doing anything wrong. Ty for reading this post and have a good day.

title: Apealing A Permaban

replies.author: Camemes
replies.body:
Hello FlameKilla.

I am the Mod that banned you, I have evidence to support the ban that I will upload now. Please be little patient while I upload this.

Regards,
Cammy G
Avicus Moderator

replies.body:
Hello, It has been more than 24 hours since you said you had evidence to ban me. Either I'm too retarded to see the evidence, you have no evidence or that the evidence has not come through. If there isn't any evidence by 5pm, I should be pardoned from the ban and should be able to play on the server again.
Ty.

replies.author: Camemes
replies.body:
Apologies for the delay. I have been a bit busy, yet I have some evidence.
The evidence can be found here. I apologize for the lack of evidence as my recording software had some problems but I can assure you that I saw you hack.

A senior staff member will now review the evidence and give you a final judgement.
Until then, I will put this appeal as Reviewing.

Regards,
Cammy G
Avicus Moderator
